entities.name: Query ankyrin-repeat protein
observations: 768-aa sequence has multiple Pfam ankyrin-repeat matches, mainly across residues 167–450 and extending through the C-terminal repeat-rich region.
Local sequence matches human/mouse ANK1, ANK2, and ANK3 at 84–87% identity over about 199–207 aa, covering only 26% of query; full-length orthology/function is unresolved.
Possible role as a protein-interaction scaffold is inferred from tandem ankyrin repeats; specific localization and biological process are unsupported by the available annotations.
